questions.question: Use doubling and halving to work out 25 × 48.
What is the difference between multiplying by 1 and multiplying by 0? Give an example of each.
questions.expected_answer: Multiplying by 1 leaves the number the same: 4 875 × 1 = 4 875. Multiplying by 0 always gives 0: 4 875 × 0 = 0.

questions.question: Work out 7 × 1 999 using the distributive property, and explain the last step.
questions.expected_answer: Multiply by 2 000 instead: 7 × 2 000 = 14 000. We multiplied by 2 000, which is 1 more than 1 999, so we take away one extra 7: 14 000 − 7 = 13 993.
